reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already encodes the furthest-from-zero, number and missing rules.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated: the mapping is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: Adding the field in scheduleModel.toExternal fits the API model layer, which is used only by schedules-get. Typing the general mapper as APIScheduleListEntity slightly couples it to the list endpoint.

scope.why: Model, handler type, tests and a release note, nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: The API stays in lockstep with the app's own definition of the expected amount, and the type change is explicit and small.
